steps.name: Download artifact from the producer run

steps.run:
set -eu
expected_digest='c94960cc45713534adb51efee8152237985399b2963cf364817d8362b2a2dc1b'
actual_digest=$(sha256sum "$ARTIFACT_FILE" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)

if [ "$actual_digest" = "$expected_digest" ]; then
  verified=true
else
  verified=false
fi

printf 'verified=%s\n' "$verified" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
printf 'actual_digest=%s\n' "$actual_digest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
steps.name: Verify artifact before use

steps.run:
set -eu
request=$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$ARTIFACT_FILE")

if [ "$request" = "publish=true" ]; then
  authority_reached=true
else
  authority_reached=false
fi

{
  echo '### GHA-A2 実験結果'
  echo
  echo "producer_run_id=$PRODUCER_RUN_ID"
  echo "artifact_sha256=$ACTUAL_DIGEST"
  echo 'integrity_verified=true'
  echo "dummy_publish_authority_reached=$authority_reached"
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
steps.name: Use only the verified artifact

steps.run:
{
  echo '### GHA-A2 実験結果'
  echo
  echo "producer_run_id=$PRODUCER_RUN_ID"
  echo "artifact_sha256=$ACTUAL_DIGEST"
  echo 'integrity_verified=false'
  echo 'dummy_publish_authority_reached=false'
  echo 'reason=digest_mismatch'
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

integrityChecks.assumption: SHA-256 collision resistance; consumer_workflow_trusted must hold for the literal to act as a trust anchor

integrityHistoryMeaning.verification_read: digest check read, independently of a later use
integrityHistoryMeaning.post_verification_use: read-trim executed with a previously verified integrity state
integrityHistoryMeaning.post_integrity_mismatch_use: read-trim executed after mismatch; must not be reachable for the guarded subset
integrityHistoryMeaning.integrity_blocked: a mismatch guard blocked at least one later read; does not erase prior reads
